method_note: SPIE SS+NDE 2026 (Vancouver, 16-19 Mar 2026) ran nine conferences, each published as its own Proceedings of SPIE volume (13944-13952). The session-level program on spie.org is behind a bot check and was not archived, so instead every published item in the nine volumes was counted from the proceedings metadata SPIE deposits at Crossref (front matter excluded): 323 items, including 13 '(Conference Presentation)' records without a manuscript. Each item was hand-assigned one taxonomy id from its title (mapping is the dataset author's judgement), and items whose title names an AI/ML method (deep learning, neural network, PINN, transformer, GNN, LLM, generative AI, random forest, autoencoder, reinforcement learning, 'AI-'/'machine learning', etc.; 39 items) were split 0.5 ai-ml + 0.5 topic. Rules: SHM/NDE/damage detection/inspection/condition monitoring -> phm; sensors, transducers, energy harvesters, flexible/wearable/implantable electronics -> mechatronics; actuator materials and devices (EAP, IPMC, DEA, coiled artificial muscles, piezo/SMA actuators) -> mechanisms; papers framed around soft robots, robotic fish/joints, soft exosuits/rehab robots or soft-robot sensing -> soft-robotics; metamaterials, vibration/wave control, materials and structural mechanics -> structures; kirigami and self-folding/folding shape-memory structures (3 items) -> deployable-structures. Result in paper-equivalents: phm 93.5, mechatronics 78.5, structures 51.5, mechanisms 36, ai-ml 23.5, soft-robotics 22.5, deployable-structures 2.5. Ids below 0.02 were dropped and the rest renormalized over 308 of 323 paper-equivalents: field-robotics 4 (quadruped/robotic inspection, submersible probe), automation 3, uav 1.5, and 1 or less each for estimation, medical-robotics, space-robotics (vacuum zipping actuators for space robotics), exploration (lunar regolith drilling), autonomous-vehicles, hri and multi-robot. deployable-structures is kept although below the cut-off, as in other files. The 2027 call (11 conferences) renames 'Sensors and Smart Structures Technologies...' to 'AI-Powered Sensors, Digital Twins, and Smart Structures...' and adds 'Metamaterials, Metasurfaces, and Metastructures' and a tribute conference honoring Daniel Inman; these are not reflected in the 2026 counts.
